company.name: HDFC Bank
company.business_summary: India's largest private bank post-merger with HDFC Ltd; ₹24L cr+ balance sheet; 44% CASA ratio; 60% retail loans; best-in-class asset quality (NNPA 0.33%); digital leader.

event.headline: RBI cuts repo rate by 25 bps to 6.25%
key_facts: RBI MPC votes 5:1 for 25 bps cut; stance 'accommodative'
CPI inflation 4.2% (within target); GDP growth 7.0% forecast
First cut since Apr 2023; signals easing cycle
Liquidity surplus ₹1.5L cr; SDF cut to 6.0%
unknowns: Pace of further cuts (25 vs 50 bps)
Transmission to lending rates (MCLR vs EBLR)

channels.reason: Direct beneficiary; credit growth acceleration; NIM stable on deposit franchise
